text: Mulțumesc! Să mai treci pe la noi.

en: I'm after a Drowzee. I'd give you my Machop for one. Deal?
A Drowzee! Thanks. Muscle is strong, so he'll do all your heavy lifting.
No, that isn't a Drowzee. A Drowzee is what I want.
Hmm. If you get hold of a Drowzee, come and see me.
My Drowzee never stops yawning. How is Muscle?
